documentation.subject: ${SERVICE_NAME}: more than 5% of requests are failing
documentation.content:
More than 5% of requests over ten minutes returned 5xx. A ratio rather than a count, so a quiet night with two errors does not page and a busy hour with two hundred does.

Runbook: `docs/ops/deployment-runbooks.md`, "Rolling a release back".

First three commands:

    gcloud run services describe ${SERVICE_NAME} --region europe-west3 --format='value(status.latestReadyRevisionName,spec.template.spec.containers[0].env)'
    gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="${SERVICE_NAME}" AND jsonPayload.level="error"' --freshness 30m --limit 50 --format='value(jsonPayload.event,jsonPayload.errorCode,jsonPayload.release)'
    gcloud run revisions list --service ${SERVICE_NAME} --region europe-west3 --sort-by='~metadata.creationTimestamp' --limit 5 --format='table(metadata.name,metadata.labels.release,status.conditions[0].status)'

Stop condition: if the errors began within fifteen minutes of a new revision, roll back to the previous immutable image before investigating. If they did not, the release is not the cause and a rollback will not help.
